name: Ekush: A Multipurpose and Multitype Comprehensive Database for Online & Offline Bangla Handwritten Characters
description: Ekush is a multipurpose, comprehensive handwritten Bangla character dataset compiled by Daffodil International University. It contains 367,018 handwritten character samples collected from over 3,000 human contributors of diverse ages and backgrounds across Bangladesh, covering basic characters, compound characters, modifiers, and numerals for optical character recognition research.
